policy.privacyMetaDescription: How ChungDoi collects, uses, and protects your data.
policy.termsMetaDescription: The terms that govern your use of ChungDoi.
policy.refundMetaDescription: When and how ChungDoi issues refunds.
policy.privacyS1B: We collect the information you provide when creating an invitation: bride and groom names, photos, wedding date, venue and guest list. We also collect basic technical data such as browser type and page views to improve the service.
policy.privacyS2B: Information is used to display your wedding invitation, manage RSVP responses and support you when needed. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
policy.privacyS3B: Your invitation is only visible to people who have the link. We only share data with infrastructure providers necessary to operate the service.
policy.privacyS4B: You can edit or delete your invitation and guest data at any time. Contact our support team if you need help with your personal data.
policy.termsS1B: By using ChungDoi to create online wedding invitations, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the service.
policy.termsS2B: You are responsible for the content, photos and information published on your invitation. Do not use the service for unlawful purposes or to infringe the rights of others.
policy.termsS3B: Creating and customizing an invitation is free. After the 3-day trial, a one-time payment keeps your invitation live forever. There are no recurring fees.
policy.termsS4B: We strive to keep the service stable but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. See the refund policy for outage cases.
policy.refundS1B: We provide refunds for duplicate charges, unauthorized charges, or an outage we cannot fix within 7 days.
policy.refundS2B: You get a free 3-day trial to preview the live invitation before deciding to pay, which minimizes the need for refunds.
policy.refundS3B: Contact our support team with your payment details. We will process the request as soon as possible.
